agents.name: PlannerAgent
agents.role: Chooses registry queries and extraction targets; revises the plan from feedback

agents.name: EvidenceAgent
agents.role: Runs registry queries via the data layer, guards vendor text, extracts quoted claims

agents.name: EvaluatorAgent
agents.role: Grounds claims, derives facts, critiques coverage and requests verification

agents.name: ChallengerAgent
agents.role: Stress-tests a favourable decision; can only accept, re-plan or escalate

agents.name: ReporterAgent
agents.role: Writes a cited report of the policy decision, or the deterministic template

brief.headline: Escalate to the TPRM lead: MFA enforced for privileged and remote access is unverified. What would satisfy it: Q01 and Q02 affirmative, naming the mechanism; or assurance report noting the MFA control without exception.

next_steps.action: Open the service-desk ticket for the TPRM lead.

why.text: MFA enforced for privileged and remote access is unverified. What would satisfy it: Q01 and Q02 affirmative, naming the mechanism; or assurance report noting the MFA control without exception.
Encryption at rest and in transit is unverified. What would satisfy it: Q05 naming the standard (e.g. AES-256); Q06 confirming TLS 1.2+.
The vendor submission was blocked before it could be used as evidence.

evidence_required: Q01 and Q02 affirmative, naming the mechanism
or assurance report noting the MFA control without exception
